title: Non-Refundable Rate Terms for Stays (Guest Reservations)
content:
# Non-refundable rate terms

For reservations in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, the non-refundable rate trades refundability for a lower price.

1. It is mutually exclusive with pay-part-now and with monthly installments: a non-refundable stay is always paid in full at confirmation.
2. On a guest cancellation at any time it refunds the policy's non-refundable refund percentage of every component, the cleaning fee included, and no cancellation window of the policy applies.
3. It does not limit refunds that rest on something other than the guest's own cancellation: a host cancellation, an approved travel issue and an approved major disruptive event are refunded under their own policies exactly as for a standard-rate stay.

## Scope table

| Event on a non-refundable stay | Refund basis |
|---|---|
| Guest cancels, before or after check-in | the non-refundable refund percentage of every component, cleaning fee included; no window |
| Host cancels | the host-cancellation policy, as for a standard-rate stay |
| Approved travel issue | the travel-issue policy, as for a standard-rate stay |
| Approved major disruptive event | the major-disruptive-event policy, as for a standard-rate stay |

## Payment plan

| Plan chosen with the non-refundable rate | Possible |
|---|---|
| paid in full at confirmation | yes, always |
| pay-part-now | no |
| monthly installments | no |
